d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from DR Congo vs Uzbekistan in Group K of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, Georgia. After Eldor Shomurodov gave Uzbekistan a 10th-minute lead and Nathanaël Mbuku had a goal overturned by VAR, Yoane Wissa converted a 68th-minute penalty before substitute Fiston Mayele put DR Congo ahead in the 78th minute and Wissa struck again in stoppage time to seal a 3-1 comeback win and a historic spot in the Round of 32.
